entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this piece of junk VeloBand Pulse you sold me. It's an absolute nightmare.

I'm very sorry to hear you're not happy with the product. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Are you kidding me? It's just plain hard to use! The whole interface is completely confusing. I read the user manual front to back and it's still useless. I expected more from VeloFit. This is unacceptable.
I understand your frustration. Sometimes the advanced features can take a little getting used to. Could you tell me which feature you're finding confusing? I might be able to walk you through it.
I don't want a tutorial, I want my money back! I've had it with this thing. This is ridiculous. Get me your manager, right now! I'm about to post a review on every single website about this disaster.
Okay, I understand. A manager isn't necessary, I can handle this for you. Please give me just one moment to check the return policy for your order.
You'd better. I know my rights. It's been about a month, and this thing is going back in the box.

Okay, I've pulled up your account. I see you received the VeloBand Pulse 33 days ago. And let me see... yes, our company policy allows for returns on items within 90 days of delivery. You are well within that timeframe.
So you're processing the refund? Finally.

Yes, absolutely. I'm authorizing the return for a full refund right now. I've just sent a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file. Just pack the item in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be processed.
Fine. That's what you should have done from the start. Don't waste my time next time.
I appreciate your patience. The email with the label should be in your inbox shortly. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
